presets.label: Grok
presets.note: Fills a draft in a Grok Bot chat and brings it forward. Nothing is sent until you press Return in Grok Bot; then the text goes to Grok Bot's cloud computer.

presets.label: Cursor
presets.note: Fills a new chat in Cursor. Nothing is sent until you press Return there.

presets.label: Claude
presets.note: Fills a new chat in the Claude app. Nothing is sent until you press Return there.
